item.title: Lawrence school board approves tax incentive for downtown development, defers approval of calendars
item.description: The Lawrence school board on Tuesday agreed to a tax incentive for developments at the former Reuter buildings and deferred a vote on the district's 2026-28 calendars to look into adding a paid holiday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas’ Chiefs deal criticized by both parties over ‘tax giveaways for billionaires’
item.description: In a crowded hearing last week, Kansas lawmakers drilled a lawyer for the Kansas City Chiefs on the deal to bring the NFL team across the state line. Republicans and Democrats are forming rare alliances on both sides of the issue. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Humane Pet of the Week: Loverboy Zissou seeks adopter to prevent his first shelter anniversary
item.description: It's natural to reflect on love and relationships with Valentine's Day on the horizon, but Pet of the Week Zissou is looking to stave off a major anniversary with the Lawrence Humane Society. Continue reading ...

item.title: Community invited to open house on completing the Lawrence Loop; online comment form open
item.description: As a city planning team works to complete the Lawrence Loop of connected trails, the Bike Plan Steering Committee will solicit feedback from community members in an open house. Continue reading ...

item.title: ‘War is hell’: 102-year-old Lawrence WWII veteran speaks so history isn’t forgotten
item.description: Nate Ericson, a Lawrence resident who turned 102 this month, says he thinks people need a reminder of what he learned eight decades ago in the Battle of the Bulge: "War is hell." Continue reading ...

item.title: ‘This bill spits on basic human decency’: Kansas Legislature passes bathroom ban without hearing
item.description: The GOP-led Kansas House and Senate on Wednesday suspended rules to approve a “bathroom bill” targeting transgender people after House Democrats delayed passage by six hours. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence forum expands on ways to improve accessibility in arts
item.description: Folks involved in Lawrence’s arts scene during a forum Wednesday came up with ways beyond audio description that they can incorporate accessibility into the arts for people who are blind or visually impaired. Continue reading ...

item.title: John Green passion rages on as KU Reads prepares for spring events
item.description: John Green fever will continue to sweep Lawrence with KU Reads’ spring slate of events themed around the author’s essay collection “The Anthropocene Reviewed.” Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas Democrats tout bill requiring ICE to display IDs, shed masks and forego warrantless searches
item.description: A coalition of Kansas House Democrats urged passage of a bill requiring ICE agents operating in Kansas to forego warrantless raids, undergo a law enforcement training program and clearly identify themselves in public. Continue reading ...
